baseline: Current dirty tree at start of second design task, captured in baseline-manifest.json and baseline.patch, plus explicit equivalent benchmark adapter.

acceptance.unary: Projection construction saves >=25% B/op without extra allocations; warm CTE/projection rendering paired95%CPU upperbound <=5%.
acceptance.projection: Reused output eliminates2alloc/512B; owned extraction paired95%CPU upperbound <=5%; no assertion of CPU gain when interval spans0.

rounds.initial: Unary payload plus projection append; owned methods delegated append(nil), rejected due owned extraction +9.66% CPU, CI6.77..12.62%.
rounds.final-projection: Same unary code and append methods; restore original exact-sized owned methods. All7 projection workloads measured fresh against original dirty baseline; no extra unchanged-candidate rounds.

harness_difference: Baseline designAppendProjection uses append(dst,p.Expressions()...) and append(dst,p.Metadata()...). Candidate uses AppendExpressions/AppendMetadata. This compares equivalent copied output with existing API allocation cost. Owned extraction remains a separate opposing workload. Nil append baseline materializes two intermediate slices; it is not the cheapest existing nil-output spelling.
host_control: No task-owned builds, tests, profilers or database server during confirmation; desktop noise, thermal/power state uncontrolled.
profile: Go default sampled alloc_space; each selected benchmark ran1s, cpu1. Raw symbolized profiles preserved. The initial profiling binary was overwritten during benchmark harness expansion, so its exact binary hash was not retained; profiles are diagnostic, never timing acceptance.
validation: Root/projection/clonegen tests passed before timing; root owns full final checks. gopls diagnostics remain blocked by pre-existing fluent.go generic method parse error.
source_artifacts: final.patch applies production/test changes to dirty baseline; benchmark fixtures stored separately. rejected-projection.go.txt reconstructs the rejected owned-method wrappers from the final file; append methods and other projection code did not change.
